[[File:Alien_settlement.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The alien settlement]]
On the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Karra]], a '''settlement''' was established by a [[Unidentified tree-like species|tree-like species]]. The colonization of the planet insulted the native [[Karran]]s, who proceeded to [[Death/Legends|kill]] the settlers. The settlement remained abandoned until it was discovered by an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] team escaping the Karrans.
